deliverables: A self-contained enumeration argument for the subsets of the stated set whose elements sum to the target.
One verified example subset meeting the target sum.
An exhaustiveness justification that partitions all eligible subsets into disjoint, complete cases.
subquestions: Which possible largest elements can occur in a subset with the specified target sum?
For each allowable largest element, which subsets of the smaller elements supply the remaining sum?
Why are the resulting cases complete and mutually non-overlapping?
Which enumerated subset can serve as the requested example?
